type NoteErr = { name: str }

is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  pre name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\"
      return False
  True

read_note(name: str) -> str fail NoteErr uses fs =
  pre is_plain_name(name)
  let text = fs.read(name) else fail NoteErr(name: copy name)
  text

try_note(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  if not is_plain_name(name)
    return None
  read_note(name) else None

first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      let text = try_note(name)
      if text != None
        return text else ""
  ""
